title: Text: DET Chad Crunk ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Trying to set up my spring schedule without bugging Ron or Aileen. Would you know by any chance when the WBC-bound players are expected to be gone?
Like when they report to their teams or what not
Hi ███████, I'm not sure when players will be reporting to their WBC teams. The first games are March 9 so I would think around March 2-3, but that's just a guess on my part
